note: Track steps-to-leaps (voice-intervals), step 12: mix of the whole octave, the scale up by step and the home chord down by skip over a drone (then turned round), then two tunes of the home chord stage that join skips through the chord to steps past La and Ti (one in two keys). The stage's Medium tunes hold only the broken chord, so the two tunes are Hard ones; the keys keep the high Do at D4 or lower for a tenor.

exercise.title: The whole octave, by step and by skip
exercise.why: The home chord is four of the eight notes from Do to the high Do, so when you go up by step and come down by skip, every skip lands on a note you sang a moment ago.

cells.heading: Up by step, down by skip

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff, the five lines of music. Sing the scale up by step from the low {{1}} to the next {{1}}. Then come down by skips on the ringed notes: {{1}}, {{5}}, {{3}}, {{1}}. Sing them on the note names.
Then turn it round: up by skips, down by step.
_Don't reach for high notes: turn back at the {{1}} in the middle of the staff._

cells.heading: Skips up, steps to the top

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. It skips up the home chord to the high Do and comes back down to Mi. Then it skips up to Sol again and steps the rest of the way: La, Ti, the high Do. Sing along on the note names.
Once the last steps land in time, try the tune in another key. Use the Key selector below to change the key, then press Play to hear the tune there.
When you change the key, the notes change but the tune still reaches the high Do once by skip and once by step.

cells.heading: Down the chord, home by step

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. It skips up to Sol, leaps to the high Do and comes down the home chord by skips. Then it skips up to Sol once more and steps down home. Sing along on the note names.
If the leap to the high Do lands off, tap that note on the staff to hear it, then sing the bar again.
Once the names come without thinking, sing it again on "la".
